thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — ran a RoPE-scaling sweep (linear / NTK / YARN) across Mistral-7B, Mixtral-8B, Qwen-7B. Seeing a sharp perf cliff on Mixtral at ~2k tokens correlated with kernel fallback.
Maria: cliff as in latency spike or OOM?
Alex: latency spike + big tail. profiler shows attention kernel switching from fused_cu_attention -> split_attention at token 2048, and split kernel is 2.3x slower for that model config.
Jia: any KV-cache touch pattern weirdness? long-context experiments often re-warm KV and cause extra matmuls.
Alex: yes — KV cache eviction + re-materialize on chunk boundary. snippet from logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] model=Mixtral-8B kernel=fused_attention seq=1984 -> ok
[2026-03-17T14:12:04Z] model=Mixtral-8B kernel=split_attention seq=2048 -> latency +120ms
[cache] evict_chunk id=42 reason=chunk_align miss=true
```
Jia: that explains double compute. Our chunking policy aligns at 2k multiples; when RoPE scale variant changes the effective position encoding, cache indexing moves and we miss.
Sam: for batching, can we do dynamic batch caps based on 95p seq_len to avoid hitting the split kernel thresh in steady-state? e.g. cap batch_seq = min(max_seq, p95_seq*1.1) and flush big seqs to separate lane.
Maria: that sounds good — also kernel selection threshold should be model-aware. For Mixtral the fused->split break is lower because of head/KV dims. We could add per-model knob in kernel-selection table.
Alex: agreed. proposed quick patch: 
```
kernel_thresholds: {
  "Mixtral-8B": 2300,
  "Mistral-7B": 3072,
  "Qwen-7B": 4096
}
```
fall back to heuristic if missing.
perf-bot: alert -> 2026-03-17T14:13:40: perf-regression detected on Mixtral-8B: p50 latency +18% for 2048 token workload.
Alex: on modeling side, RoPE variant matters: linear scaling produced best perplexity at long context for Mistral, NTK had slight divergence on Qwen after 6k tokens, YARN introduced small stability noise on Mixtral head projections. I'm attaching short per-model safe ranges:
- Mistral-7B: linear up to 6k, NTK experimental >6k (monitor ppl), YARN avoid for now.
- Mixtral-8B: NTK up to 4k, linear OK to 2.5k, YARN gives instability in head dims -> safe range linear <= 2300.
- Qwen-7B: NTK preferred for >8k, linear degrades after 5k (ppl++. monitor).
Sam: let's be specific in rollout: A/B kernels+batching on a small fleet, enable per-model kernel_thresholds, and add KV-chunk-align fix so cache keys are invariant to RoPE variant.
Maria: tests to add before wide rollout:
- microbench: fused vs split at boundary seqs (1k,2k,3k) per model
- end-to-end latency with synthetic p95 distribution
- regression evals on perplexity and callee task QA for 1k-16k ranges
- KV cache consistency test for chunk boundaries and RoPE variants
Alex: I'll open a PR with kernel_thresholds + batching heuristic patch and include profiler traces. Jia will prototype KV-alignment patch. Sam will own the canary run.
Jia: noted. I'll also add a small metric: kv_miss_ratio_by_chunk so we can alert if re-warm > 0.5%.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled -> canary: eng-runtime/rope-scaling-canary at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z.
Maria: thanks team :thumbsup: we'll monitor perf-bot and regressions channel.
